experiment_data.hypothesis: Untrained OpenVLA (OXE-pretrained, no LIBERO fine-tuning) should NOT show exit-peaking action-head R² because the LM head has not been specialized for LIBERO action decoding. If trained model shows exit-peak and untrained does not, this dissociation confirms format specialization is a training-induced effect, not an architectural artifact.
experiment_data.notes: v2 rerun with 3 bug fixes (transformers 4.40.1, no double-norm, clone hidden states). 5000 samples. All 33 layers R² negative (-5.61 to -3.55). Peak R²=-3.55 at exit layer (L32). Compared to trained v2: trained peak=-2.77 (L31), trained exit=-3.04 (L32). Both show all-negative R² - action head cannot decode meaningful actions from any layer in either model.
